speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Mesenteric Ischemia (likely due to embolism from recent MI).

The combination of sudden onset periumbilical pain, bloody stools, and recent myocardial infarction is highly suggestive of ischemic bowel. I am requesting an emergent CT angiogram of the abdomen to confirm the diagnosis.

REQUEST IMAGES: CT_Angiogram_Abdomen
